faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Atlas and our robotics solutions.

items.question: What industries can Atlas be deployed in?
items.answer: Atlas is designed for versatile deployment across manufacturing, healthcare, research, logistics, and many other industries requiring precision automation and human-robot collaboration.

items.question: How long does implementation typically take?
items.answer: Implementation timelines vary based on complexity, but most deployments are completed within 4-8 weeks, including training, integration, and optimization phases.

items.question: What safety certifications does Atlas have?
items.answer: Atlas meets or exceeds international safety standards including ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, and various industry-specific certifications for collaborative robotics.

items.question: Can Atlas work alongside human workers?
items.answer: Yes, Atlas is specifically designed for safe human-robot collaboration with advanced sensors, AI-powered situational awareness, and multiple safety systems.

items.question: What kind of support and maintenance is available?
items.answer: We provide comprehensive support including 24/7 remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, software updates, and on-site technical assistance when needed.

story.title: Innovation Meets Purpose
story.content: Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between human potential and robotic capabilities, we have been at the forefront of humanoid robotics for over a decade. Our journey began with a simple belief: technology should enhance human capabilities, not replace them.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To develop intelligent humanoid robots that augment human capabilities, enhance productivity, and create safer working environments across industries.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To be the global leader in humanoid robotics, creating a future where humans and robots collaborate seamlessly to solve the world's greatest challenges.
